introduction: Follow Ny’Neth’s ore mines, prepare five distinct samples for the foreman, and keep his accepted exchange separate from the stronghold’s longer access and rescue stories.
orientation: Arrive in this part of Ny’Neth’s Stronghold to discover it. Find the foreman in the mines to reveal his sample request.
The foreman is a golem of elemental energy. Ask him about tiloxi to hear why he needs five pure ore samples. Hearing his answer and completing the exchange are separate events.
Bring one exact chunk each of illithite, malicite, evilite, perversium and deathalite, together and loose in your inventory. Exact copies supplied by another player also fit.
The five optional material rows show what you carry now. Extra copies of one ore cannot replace a missing different ore. Golem slivers, liquid, blood and orbs are different items.
Some chunks are left near the ends of their ore veins. Remaining supplies depend on what is actually present; the mineral descriptions do not provide a new mining or carving command.
The foreman accepts the five chunks for a mine key. That exchange remains recorded after the samples are spent or the key leaves your inventory.
The mine key can open the hidden route toward the mining tracks and sorting room. Finding a door, unlocking it and crossing it are separate actions; carrying the key does not record them.
Toloxi is the faerie in the sorting room. His silver key leads toward the workshop. The foreman’s topic word tiloxi is the word to use with the foreman.
Mining carts connect otherwise separate passages. Check the destination and actual cart before committing to a ride; returning safely takes its own route.

The workshop contains summoners, demons and enslaved deep gnomes. Their plight is part of the larger story. Completing the sample exchange does not record a prisoner’s freedom or an interrupted ritual.
Further keys lead into the inner workshop, upper underworld, portal room and second vault. Some keys break when used. The painting is a shortcut with a limited number of uses.
The second vault holds the onward third-stage key and a return portal. Ny’Neth’s earlier warning explains why the means to continue should be obtained before committing to the next stage.

A monolith reward follows its own encounter, participant and reward rules. The foreman’s accepted trade, useful travel, a prisoner’s freedom and a committed monolith claim are different accomplishments.

contacts.name: an illithite golem
contacts.description: This golem if formed completely of illithite ore, reknown for its evil magical nature, and power to cause sickness and wasting in the life aura of living beings.

contacts.name: an illithite golem
contacts.description: This golem if formed completely of illithite ore, reknown for its evil magical nature, and power to cause sickness and wasting in the life aura of living beings.

contacts.name: the foreman
contacts.description: The foreman needs one exact sample of illithite, malicite, evilite, perversium and deathalite. Ask about tiloxi; bring the five chunks together for his mine key.

contacts.name: a malicite golem
contacts.description: This golem seems to be permanently enraged, pounding at the walls of the tunnel in a fury.

contacts.name: an evilite golem
contacts.description: This golem has been made of an element so incredibly evil, it grants him the abilities of a dreaded anti-paladin simply by its incorporation into a living form.

contacts.name: a perversium golem
contacts.description: About the size of an ogre, this huge golem works easily and dilligently mining perversium .

contacts.name: a deep duergar assassin
contacts.description: Hard to get an exact bead on, this duergar blends almost instantly into any shadow.

contacts.name: a deathalite golem
contacts.description: Hard to discern, this massive form radiates pure blackness into the passage.

contacts.name: a deep gnome
contacts.description: Small and stealthy, this gnome has lived its entire life without a single glimplse of sunlight.

contacts.name: a sorting golem
contacts.description: Formed of pure quartz, this large golem has been forged with an extra pair of arms.

contacts.name: Toloxi
contacts.description: Toloxi oversees the sorting room and carries a small silver key. The foreman’s sample exchange and meeting Toloxi are separate parts of the stronghold.

contacts.name: a deep cube
contacts.description: A gigantic cube of translucent slime, this acidic being makes its living by absorbing the unwary living creatures which wander past this section of tunnel.

contacts.name: a morgus demon
contacts.description: Short for a demon, this class of demon is nonetheless fearsome in battle.

contacts.name: a half-materialized demon
contacts.description: This demon floats in the air here, its body slowly materializing as it is pulled from one of the 666 planes.

contacts.name: an apprentice summoner
contacts.description: A dark elf of some variety, this apprentice summoner works in unison with her master to conjure and bind demons to service here.

contacts.name: the master summoner
contacts.description: As beautiful as she is deadly, this dark elf flexes the power of her arts in an explosion of creation here.

contacts.name: a tzuz demon
contacts.description: One of the most feared classes of demon, the Tzuz are endowed with considerable magical power.

contacts.name: an enslaved deep gnome
contacts.description: Reknowned for their natural mental powers, it must have taken very considerable power to bind this pitiful creature and his brethren to their current slavery.

contacts.name: an enslaved deep gnome
contacts.description: Reknowned for their natural mental powers, it must have taken very considerable power to bind this pitiful creature and his brethren to their current slavery.

contacts.name: an azel demon
contacts.description: Summoned from one of the 666 planes, this huge demon is from the Azel class.

contacts.name: a corus demon
contacts.description: Even under direct gaze, this corus demon is nearly undetectable.

contacts.name: a xyyn demon
contacts.description: Imbued with an absolute command over evil forces, the Xyyn need no godly allegience to weave their magic.

contacts.name: Maluzaan
contacts.description: This gigantic demon's blood red skin ripples with muscles, and its fists are disproportionately large even considering its considerable density.

contacts.name: a deep wyrm
contacts.description: Long and thick, this wingless dragon uses its four massive legs to quickly scurry through the cavern.

contacts.name: an arus demon
contacts.description: Shadows seem to collect about this demon, who stalks through the crevices Only his eyes, which burn with fiery hatred, are clearly visible in the darkness which envelopes him.

contacts.name: a tortured soul
contacts.description: Appearing only as a translucent twisting mass of writhing agony, this soul cries out as though under constant torture.

contacts.name: a taus devil
contacts.description: This devil is a fearsome sight as it creeps noiselessly through the caverns here looking for amusement.

contacts.name: a painseeker
contacts.description: A form of beholder, this floating eye roams the underworld seeking out beings on which to cause pain.

contacts.name: Nogoz'Tzel, devil of the 308'th plane
contacts.description: The size of a giant, this devil muscular and well built.

contacts.name: Slyten
contacts.description: Short and stocky for a drow, this wizard's great powers quickly transcend his height disadvantages.

contacts.name: Tuosceck the Blizzard King
contacts.description: His scales are a shimmering mix of blazing white and blue, running the length of his body in semi random patterns.

contacts.name: Gormash the berserker lord
contacts.description: One of the winged devils of Aazaeroth, this horrific being stands nearly twelve feet tall.

contacts.name: an ancient roper
contacts.description: Not much differentiates this roper from the other huge ropers which roam the underdark except for its immense size.

contacts.name: Sythuun the Reaper lord
contacts.description: Words cannot descibe the bone-chilling terror that emanates from this moving blackness as it quickly closes in.

contacts.name: Jugger the golem
contacts.description: Not a solid mass, this golem is instead made up of huge stone boulders animated together in a humanoid shape.

stories.title: Five ores for the foreman
stories.summary: The foreman trades a mine key for one exact chunk of each of five ores. Recovered or supplied samples fit; workshop, prisoner and onward campaign outcomes are separate.
